position_rules: Twelve BIP39 dictionary words encode entropy/checksum; legacy random/Byron master-key semantics, not Icarus or Ledger.

external_secret.guidance: Any supported mnemonic passphrase stays outside Tessaveil; wallet login/spending passwords are distinct. Paper27 already includes its nine password words; no extra secret is inferred.

semantic_distinction: Deprecated random-address Daedalus mode; initial entropy preprocessing, backend artifact and full fixed recovery not reproduced. Non-selectable.
